manifest.name: dsh-usage-state
manifest.description: Shows the current provider's account balance or coding-plan quota above the composer, with usage percentages and reset countdowns.

bundle.text:
# Mount layer contributed by this plugin.
#
# `dsh plugin add` appends this package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`,
# which applies this patch on boot.
#
# The row id **is the settings namespace** on DSH 0.2 (`configForms.get(id)` on the
# client, `entry.options.id` on the host), so it has to keep matching
# `USAGE_STATE_NS` in `src/host/settings.ts`.
#
# `config: {}` gives every install a section to resolve: without it the entry has
# no config at all, the settings projection answers `undefined`, and the status
# line stays silent until the user saves something. A user's own
# `- id: usage-state, config: { … }` row still replaces this whole value, because
# the profile patch layer applies after every bundle layer.
- insert:
    - id: usage-state
      name: dsh-usage-state
      config: {}

> **0.4.15** 新增 OpenAI 组织月消费（Admin Key）、插件内设置与草稿保存／重置，并修复旧配置保存、端点编辑、凭据归属及生命周期取消。宿主支持声明保持不变。安装包及校验文件见 [GitHub Release](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-usage-state/releases/tag/v0.4.15)，详情见 [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md#0415---2026-11-06)。

在 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 输入框上方显示当前模型供应商的**账户余额**或**套餐额度**。状态行与输入卡片同宽，保留原生统计行和上下文计量器。

```text
z.ai / GLM · ◔ 5h 12% (4h0m) · ◔ 7d 59% (3d17h)
DeepSeek · ¥58.13
```

- 已识别的供应商默认使用“自动”，复用DSH已有凭据；每个provider配置一次，模型列表用于参考。
- 显示余额、已用百分比、重置倒计时和SVG进度环；默认≥80%琥珀、≥95%红，可调整阈值和隐藏进度环。
- 可显式启用 OpenAI Admin 模式，显示整个组织在当前 UTC 月已报告的 USD 消费，独立于余额与套餐额度。
- 同一有效账户身份的源请求失败时保留上次成功读数并标记陈旧、年龄和原因；RPC传输失败也会明确标出旧值。
- 悬停查看数据源、模式、重置时刻及余额构成；中英界面跟随DSH语言设置。
- 只显示账户当前读数，不做成本归因、价格目录、预算或历史账单。

要求：DSH版本满足 `^0.2.0-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.1`（已验证0.2.0-rc.2及0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2/rc.3/rc.5），运行预构建插件声明Node≥20，安装到正在使用的 `web` profile。


本仓库提交预构建产物，供DSH的GitHub安装路径直接使用。浮动GitHub分支可能领先于npm；复现问题时记录安装来源和版本/提交。不要把这一行为推广到所有npm Git安装。

也可通过 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 搜索 `余额与额度`、`Balance & Quota`、`dsh-usage-state` 或 `takboo` 安装；安装后核对实际来源与版本。本插件已进入 [精选列表](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)；目录更新的可见时间取决于所用区域与成功构建。

DSH0.1使用历史版本0.3.2；该版本不适配0.2。0.4.0有RPC挂载缺陷，应升级至**最新兼容版**。完整版本记录见 [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md)。
0.4.15 起使用以下插件内设置入口与草稿操作，0.4.14 及更早版本仍使用原独立设置入口。新入口已在 Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 实机打开，并在同版隔离浏览器完成保存／重置验证；支持声明中的更早宿主仍待补验该入口，历史 RPC 检查不代表新配置页已验收。

1. 打开 **插件 → 余额与额度 → 配置**，不再从全局设置侧栏进入。
2. 每个供应商一行，用下拉菜单选择“自动”、支持的 API Key 余额／账号余额／Coding Plan，或“隐藏”；行内查看检测模式、来源和状态，模型清单与高级覆盖默认折叠。
3. 自建 Sub2API 复用供应商已有接口地址；仅在地址缺失或需要覆盖时展开高级设置填写。账号模式由 Harness 管理登录，不提供 API Key 输入；OpenAI 官方普通密钥仍不查余额，可手动选择“组织月消费（Admin Key）”，配置独立 Admin 凭据。
4. 修改模式、排序、端点、刷新策略或显示选项后，点击**保存设置**统一生效；**重置**采用最新已保存配置，离开页面则丢弃未保存草稿。未保存的配置不改变输入框上方状态行。
5. “立即刷新”主动查询**已保存配置**的读数，不保存草稿；出错查看行内原因及 [排查指南](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-usage-state/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)。

**凭据名不是密钥本身。** 使用 `OAI_USAGE_READONLY` 这类名称，格式为 `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`：首字符只能是英文字母或下划线，后续可含数字，不支持连字符、空格或中文。API Key 与 Admin 凭据名不合法时，设置页会提示并阻止保存设置及写入／清除密钥；修正名称即可，无需靠重启解决。

**配置与凭据分开保存。** 密钥区域的“立即保存密钥／立即清除密钥”是独立操作，不随配置重置撤回。修改模式、来源、端点或凭据名后，须先保存设置并取得当前目标的权限描述，才能操作密钥；显示或排序草稿不阻止独立密钥操作。API Key 高级设置提供端点、凭据名和密钥入口；显式 provider 覆盖优先于旧 source 默认，凭据描述与读取共用候选顺序。固定端点不试镜像，配置或凭据身份变化后清除旧身份读数。配置与凭据写权限分别处理；保存中防止重复提交，失败保留配置草稿。若其他页面已修改配置，先重置并重新修改，不静默覆盖外部变更。

| 来源 | 余额／消费读数 | Coding Plan读数 | 主要凭据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek官方 API Key | CNY/USD余额 | — | DEEPSEEK_API_KEY |
| DeepSeek账号登录 | CNY/USD充值与赠送余额 | — | Harness当前登录账号 |
| OpenAI官方 | 普通密钥无余额接口；显式 Admin 模式显示组织级本月 USD 消费（非余额） | — | 手动独立 adminKeyRef；自动不读取密钥 |
| z.ai / 智谱GLM | — | 5h / 7d已用% | ZAI_API_KEY等 |
| Kimi / Moonshot | 人民币余额 | Kimi Code订阅窗口 | MOONSHOT_API_KEY / KIMI_CODING_API_KEY |
| OpenCode Zen Go | — | 5h / 7d / 30d已用% | OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY / OPENCODE_API_KEY |
| Sub2API | 余额或key配额 | 按实例响应，如5h / 1d / 7d / 30d | SUB2API_API_KEY及实例地址 |

**DeepSeek 桌面端账号登录**：`deepseek-account` 路由自动选择「账号余额」，通过 Harness 登录服务读取充值与赠送余额之和，无需 API Key；`deepseek-official` 路由选择「API Key 余额」。两者独立查询和缓存，账号模式不会探测或回退使用 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。请在 Harness 账号设置中登录；账号模式要求宿主提供账号服务；旧宿主缺少该服务时需升级宿主。账号模式的端点与登录凭据由宿主管理，高级区不提供 API Key 输入。

**OpenAI 官方：** 自动模式和普通 API Key 模式仍只提示余额接口限制，并提供[官方账单入口](https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/billing/overview)，不读取普通密钥或探测余额接口。要查看消费：

1. 由组织 owner 在 [Admin keys](https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/admin-keys) 创建管理密钥，尽可能仅授予读取 Usage 的权限；普通项目／推理密钥不可替代。不要因 403 自动扩大权限。
2. 在供应商行手动选择“组织月消费（Admin Key）”，填写**独立 Admin 凭据名**并先保存设置，再在凭据区立即保存密钥；也可引用已由宿主管理的同名凭据。密钥不写入插件配置，不自动发现或复用推理凭据。
3. 读数来自官方 [Costs API](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/admin/subresources/organization/subresources/usage/methods/costs.md)，是**整个组织在当前 UTC 日历月已报告的 USD 消费**，不是本项目、当前模型／会话或此密钥自身消费，更不是余额、预算剩余或最终账单。提示中显示实际月份及查询时间；可能有入账延迟，查询时间不代表数据已入账至该时刻。完整查询无金额行显示“暂无数据”，明确返回 0 才显示零。费用按 UTC 日桶查询，省略当前秒 `end_time` 以免排除当天费用；返回桶仍按捕获时钟限制在本月截至当日。

官方来源优先按解析后的精确主机名 `api.openai.com` 识别，不按模型名、OpenAI 协议或字符串包含关系判断；第三方兼容平台仍按其余额协议接入。Admin 请求另有更严格的安全策略：固定 `https://api.openai.com/v1/organization/costs`、拒绝重定向，不使用 HTTP、自定义端口、网关／端点覆盖。若要将网关模型路由显式关联到官方组织消费，需手动选 OpenAI 来源，不能自动推断二者账户相同。换凭据或 UTC 跨月清除旧消费；同身份同月刷新失败才保留旧值。当前每个 source+mode 仍只有首个有效供应商拥有目标，不代表独立多组织支持。

Kimi Code 的 `kimi-code`、`kimi-coding`、`kimi-for-coding` provider，以及声明 `api.kimi.com` / `api.kimi.ai` 的自定义 provider，会自动读取套餐用量。支持 5h、7d、月总额度及编程月用量，仅展示账户实际返回的窗口。Moonshot 国内/国际 API 继续显示人民币余额；可在设置中显式选择模式。

百分比表示**已用**。z.ai的key分国内/国际区域；默认国内地址，失败可尝试镜像。当前缓存按数据源与模式合并，不能将不同密钥/实例视为已支持独立多账户。厂商端点、字段和扩展步骤见 [适配器指南](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-usage-state/blob/main/docs/adapters.md)。

暗色下展开官方 DeepSeek 高级项：模型仅供参考，端点与凭据引用按需覆盖；密钥保存／清除为独立即时操作，不受配置 Reset 撤销。

宿主默认在回合结束2秒后调度刷新，并有5分钟兜底定时器；浏览器每30秒拉取RPC镜像。普通轮询仅在读数缺失或有效身份变化时初始化查询，不把idle查询改成每分钟一次。成功请求的默认最小间隔为60秒，显式刷新可绕过，失败的主动重试不受该成功间隔限制；修改空闲间隔会重调定时器。

插件查询余额/额度并读取当前模型及供应商目录，不写会话日志，也不向第三方上报这些读数。宿主不把已保存的密钥值返回浏览器；用户主动粘贴的草稿经DSH凭据服务写入所用home的凭据文件。凭据优先级跟随宿主：DSH 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2/rc.3 的 Web/桌面端优先使用已保存凭据，环境变量作为回退；0.2.0-rc.2 则优先使用环境变量。凭据权限以设置页实际返回为准。

完整整改状态及验证范围见 [待办清单](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-usage-state/blob/main/docs/backlog.md)。

- **账户范围**：仍按source+mode选择一个目标；配置身份隔离不等于新增独立多账户支持。
- **未验证范围**：真实 Desktop 账号登录与余额对照、Kimi Code月额度真实账户、Sub2API真实账户、长名／中文设置页及高阈值视觉、真实凭据写入和OpenCode非零路径仍缺活体验证；本地交互测试不代替这些验收。
- **范围**：无模型选择或隐藏时可以不显示；点击状态行不打开设置；不保存历史读数。

> **0.4.15** adds OpenAI organization monthly spend (Admin Key), plugin-row configuration and local Save/Reset drafts. It fixes legacy configuration saves, endpoint editing, credential ownership and lifecycle cancellation while keeping the existing host support declarations. See the [GitHub Release](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-usage-state/releases/tag/v0.4.15) for the tarball and checksum and the [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md#0415---2026-11-06) for details.

Show the current model provider's **account balance** or **coding-plan quota** above the composer input in [DSH (DeepSeek Harness)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). The line matches the input card's width and preserves the native statistics and context meter.

```text
z.ai / GLM · ◔ 5h 12% (4h0m) · ◔ 7d 59% (3d17h)
DeepSeek · ¥58.13
```

- Recognized providers default to Auto and reuse existing DSH credentials. Configuration is per provider; the model list is informational.
- Balances, used percentages, reset countdowns and SVG rings, with configurable amber/red thresholds (80%/95% by default) and an option to hide rings.
- An explicit OpenAI Admin mode reports organization-wide USD spend for the current UTC month, separately from balances and plan quotas.
- A failed source request keeps the last successful reading for the same effective account identity, with its age and reason. An RPC failure also marks retained values as stale.
- Hover details include source, mode, reset time and balance components. The UI follows DSH's Chinese/English language setting.
- Current account readings only: no cost attribution, price catalog, budgets or historical bills.

Requires DSH matching `^0.2.0-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.1` (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2/rc.3/rc.5). The prebuilt plugin declares Node ≥20. Install into the `web` profile you actually use.

Install from npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-usage-state
```

readme.text: Use historical version 0.3.2 on DSH 0.1; it does not work on 0.2. Version 0.4.0 has a broken RPC mount, so upgrade to the **latest compatible release**. See the [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) for version history.

Version 0.4.15 introduces the plugin-row settings entry and draft workflow below; 0.4.14 and earlier use the separate settings entry. The new entry has been opened on Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5, with Save/Reset verified in an isolated browser on the same version. Earlier hosts in the declared range still need entry-specific validation; historical RPC checks do not certify the migrated page.

1. Open **Plugins → Balance & Quota → Configure**, rather than the global settings sidebar.
2. Each provider has one compact row. Choose Auto, a supported API Key balance / Account balance / Coding Plan mode, or Hidden from its dropdown. The row shows the detected mode, source and status; models and advanced overrides stay collapsed.
3. Sub2API reuses the provider's existing endpoint. Expand advanced settings only when an address is missing or an override is needed. Harness manages account-mode sign-in, with no API key input. Ordinary OpenAI keys still cannot query a balance; explicitly select “Organization spend (Admin Key)” and configure a separate Admin credential to opt in.
4. Click **Save settings** to apply mode, order, endpoint, refresh and display changes together. **Reset** adopts the latest saved configuration; leaving the page discards unsaved edits. Draft configuration does not change the line above the composer.
5. **Refresh now** explicitly queries readings for the **saved configuration**; it does not save edits. Check the row's reason and the [troubleshooting guide (Chinese)](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-usage-state/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md) on failure.

**A credential name is not the secret itself.** Use a name such as `OAI_USAGE_READONLY`, matching `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`: start with an ASCII letter or underscore, followed by letters, digits, or underscores. Hyphens, spaces, and non-ASCII characters are not supported. Invalid API Key or Admin credential names show a validation message and block settings saves and key writes/deletions. Correct the name; a restart does not fix invalid syntax.

**Configuration and credentials save separately.** **Save key now / Clear key now** are immediate actions and are not undone by resetting configuration. After editing a provider's mode, source, endpoint or credential name, save settings and wait for the current target's permission description before editing its key. Display or order drafts do not block independent key actions. API Key advanced settings offer endpoint, credential name and key controls. Explicit provider overrides take precedence over legacy source defaults, and descriptions and requests share the candidate order. Pinned endpoints do not try mirrors; configuration or credential identity changes discard previous-identity readings. Configuration and credential permissions are separate. Pending saves prevent duplicate submissions, and failed saves preserve the draft. If another page changes configuration, reset and reapply your edits rather than silently overwriting external changes.

| Source | Balance / spend reading | Coding-plan reading | Main credential |
|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek official API Key | CNY/USD balance | — | DEEPSEEK_API_KEY |
| DeepSeek account sign-in | CNY/USD recharge and bonus balance | — | Current Harness login |
| Official OpenAI | No ordinary-key balance API; explicit Admin mode reports organization-wide UTC-month USD spend, not balance | — | Separate manual adminKeyRef; no auto key lookup |
| z.ai / Zhipu GLM | — | 5h / 7d used % | ZAI_API_KEY and related refs |
| Kimi / Moonshot | CNY balance | Kimi Code subscription windows | MOONSHOT_API_KEY / KIMI_CODING_API_KEY |
| OpenCode Zen Go | — | 5h / 7d / 30d used % | OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY / OPENCODE_API_KEY |
| Sub2API | Balance or key allowance | Depends on the instance, e.g. 5h / 1d / 7d / 30d | SUB2API_API_KEY and instance URL |

**DeepSeek Desktop account sign-in:** `deepseek-account` automatically uses “Account balance” through the Harness account service, adding recharge and bonus wallets. `deepseek-official` uses “API Key balance”. Queries and caches are separate; account mode never probes or falls back to `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. Sign in through Harness account settings. Account mode requires the host account service; older hosts without it need an upgrade. Harness owns the endpoint and login grant; account mode has no API key fields.

**Official OpenAI:** auto and ordinary-key modes still explain the balance API limitation and link to [official billing](https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/billing/overview), without looking up an ordinary key or probing a balance endpoint. To opt into spend reporting:

1. An organization owner creates a key in [Admin keys](https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/admin-keys), granting only read access to Usage where possible. Ordinary project/inference keys cannot replace it; do not automatically expand permissions after a 403.
2. Explicitly select “Organization spend (Admin Key)”, enter a **separate Admin credential name**, and save settings first. Then save the key immediately in the credential area, or reference a credential already managed by Harness. Secrets never enter plugin config; inference credentials are not discovered or reused for this mode.
3. The official [Costs API](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/admin/subresources/organization/subresources/usage/methods/costs.md) reports **organization-wide USD spend reported so far in the current UTC calendar month**. This is not project-, model-, session-, or key-specific, and is not a balance, remaining budget, or final invoice. The tooltip shows the actual month and query time; ingestion may lag, and the query timestamp is not an ingestion watermark. A complete query without cost rows shows “No cost data”; only an explicitly returned numeric zero displays zero.

Official-source detection uses the exact parsed hostname `api.openai.com`, not model names, protocol compatibility, or substring matching. Third-party gateways require their own balance protocol. Admin transport is stricter: it always uses `https://api.openai.com/v1/organization/costs` with redirects rejected, ignoring HTTP/custom-port/gateway endpoint overrides. Explicitly select the OpenAI source to associate a gateway model route with official organization spend; the plugin cannot infer that these accounts match. Credential changes and UTC month rollover clear old spend; failures retain values only for the same identity and month. Only the first effective provider owns each source+mode target; this is not independent multi-organization support.

Kimi Code routes `kimi-code`, `kimi-coding`, and `kimi-for-coding`, plus custom providers declaring `api.kimi.com` / `api.kimi.ai`, automatically read subscription usage. The plugin displays only returned windows: 5h, 7d, monthly total, and monthly code usage. Moonshot regional APIs retain CNY balance mode. Explicit settings take precedence.

Percentages mean **used**. z.ai keys belong to their China/global region; China is the default endpoint and failures may try the mirror. The current cache merges by source and mode, so separate keys/instances must not be treated as supported independent accounts. Endpoints, field semantics and extension steps are in the [adapter guide (Chinese)](https://github.com/takboo/dsh-usage-state/blob/main/docs/adapters.md).

The host schedules refreshes 2 seconds after a turn ends and has a 5-minute fallback timer. The browser reads the RPC mirror every 30 seconds. Ordinary polling initializes a missing or changed account identity, otherwise it does not shorten idle queries to once a minute. Successful requests have a default 60-second minimum; explicit refresh can bypass it, and active retries after failure are not throttled by that successful-request interval. Editing the idle interval reschedules the timer.

The plugin queries balances/quotas and reads the selected model and provider catalog. It writes no session logs and reports no readings to third parties. The host does not return stored key values to the browser; a key the user actively pastes is sent through DSH's credential service to the credential file in the selected home. Credential precedence follows the host: DSH 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2/rc.3 Web/Desktop prefers saved credentials, with environment values as fallback; 0.2.0-rc.2 prefers the environment. The settings page reflects the host’s actual write permissions.
